katie_pm: PRD kickoff — smart routing resilience & fallbacks. Need acceptance criteria + launch gates by EOD Wed. Customers pushing for regional failover. TL;DR: tiers, region mapping, model-variant compatibility, and clear rollback/runbook.

dmitri_eng: noted. I'll draft SLOs and acceptance tests. Do we require per-tenant overrides or enterprise pinning in v1?

maya_research: yes — enterprise pinning should be allowed, but can be gated behind Dedicated/Private. Also we need explicit behavior for token-prefix vs whole-request fallback (conversation continuity).

alex_infra: question: do we allow cross-region routing for latency-sensitive tiers? that has big cost + compliance implications.

sam_devops: recommend policy sketch:
- tier0 = strict latency (no cross-region by default, only with explicit tenant opt-in)
- tier1 = best-effort cross-region (fall back if same-region capacity exhausted)
- tier2 = cost-first (aggressive cross-region + cheaper model variants)
what do folks think?

katie_pm: :thumbsup: that separation maps well to customer asks. Can we capture acceptance criteria as a checklist?

maya_research: agreed. Also call out model-variant compatibility matrix (quantized vs fp16, tokenizer variants) — fallback must only route to compatible variants or signal a partial-loss.

katie_pm: ```Acceptance criteria:
- Tier mapping enforced per request header and console settings.
- Tier0 p95 RTT <= 120ms in same region under 99th percentile load.
- Fallbacks limited: Tier0 fallback_rate < 1% over 24h; Tier1 < 5%; Tier2 < 20%.
- Conversation continuity: when fallback occurs, either KV cache preserved or user-visible warning emitted.
- Model compatibility: router consults compatibility matrix; incompatible variant must not be selected.
- Observability: metrics exist for route_success_rate, fallback_rate_by_tier, fallback_reason tags, and per-tenant counters.
- Runbook: documented rollback (disable auto-fallback, switch to pinned model, regional-only mode).
```

dmitri_eng: nice. Edge cases to add to PRD: model-variant with different tokenizer leading to bad partial responses; KV cache mismatch across model families; request timeouts mid-stream; multi-stage requests (rerank -> gen) where components route differently.

alex_infra: infra list: update router config API, new /compatibility-matrix endpoint (model -> compatible_variants), add routing policy flags in tenant config, and SSM secrets for region-to-region routing keys. Also we need cost-visibility per routed decision.

sam_devops: runbook sketch: if fallback_rate spike for tier0:
1) auto-disable cross-region fallback for affected tenants
2) switch to pinned model in same region if available
3) send outage ticket and increase sampling for traces
4) if still failing, throttle non-critical routes
I'll convert into a playbook entry.

oncall-bot: incidentbot: alert rule created: "fallback-spike" when fallback_rate > 5% for 5m for tier0/tier1. Pager on for SRE-lead.

katie_pm: scope negotiation: propose v1 MVP = region-aware routing + tier mapping + compatibility matrix enforcement + basic observability + runbook. v2 = enterprise pinning UI, cost-driven dynamic routing, and per-tenant throttles. Is that acceptable?

maya_research: agree to hold enterprise pinning as opt-in for Dedicated/Private in v1 if implementation risk high. Add explicit acceptance criteria for token loss behavior: document when prefix loss acceptable and when we must preserve it.

dmitri_eng: timeline proposal: RFC by Fri (draft tests + compatibility matrix schema), PRD review Mon, engineering spike week after signoff. I estimate infra work 2w, runtime changes 3w, e2e + testing 1w.

alex_infra: +/-1 week depending on validation harness. Also need to flag potential perf regression when checking compatibility matrix per-request — consider caching.

katie_pm: ok. I'll capture this thread into the PRD skeleton and assign RFC to @dmitri_eng. action items:
- dmitri: RFC + tests (due Fri)
- alex: compatibility endpoint design + infra estimate (due Tue)
- sam: runbook draft + alert tuning (due Tue)
- maya: list token/kv continuity acceptance cases (due Tue)
Thanks team, I'll follow up with calendar for PRD review.

sam_devops: one more: we should include a small customer-facing section describing "what to expect" on failover (lossy vs seamless) so support gets consistent messaging.

katie_pm: good call — will add explanatory section and sample API headers for tenant overrides.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled a notice to #customers-notify for rollout when flag flips in staging.
